$comment: 语法大厅 G26（V0.9 P2a 骨架层收官课）。比喻锚点：延音线——从过去一直拉到现在还在响。KET 限定版：只讲 just/yet/already/never/ever/for/since 七个搭配（官方考纲边界）；been vs gone、过去完成时一概不碰，留给进阶层 G27/G28，末尾一句带过。全部内容原创。
title: 现在完成时（KET 限定七搭配）
metaphor: 延音线：从过去一直拉到现在还在响
ketNote: KET 考纲只要求现在完成时配 just/yet/already/never/ever/for/since 七个搭配——把这七个拉稳就是满分线，更深的用法不考。

sections.essence: 延音线：过去按下的音，现在还在响——have/has + 过去分词。
sections.why: G13 里你学过：昨天的事盖过去戳，说完就翻篇——I lost my key yesterday，丢没丢回来不知道，反正是昨天的事。可英语还有一种时态，专说「过去发生、现在还在起作用」的事：I have lost my key——重点根本不是什么时候丢的，而是「现在我进不了门」。这就是现在完成时：一条延音线，把过去按下的音一直拉到现在，还在响。中文的「了」和「过」其实早给你打了底：「我吃过四川菜」的「过」，跟 I have tried Sichuan food 神似。装备是 have/has + 过去分词——分词规则动词照旧 -ed，不规则的是 G13 那批老团员的第三枚私章（see-saw-seen，go-went-gone）。KET 给这课划了明明白白的边界：只考它跟 just、already、yet、never、ever、for、since 七个词的搭配——七个都熟，这题就是送分。唯一的天条：延音线不跟「翻篇的时间词」同台——yesterday、last week 一出现，乖乖回去用过去时。
sections.metaphorStory: 小凡在新乐谱上看到一个陌生记号：两个音符之间弯着一条弧线，跨过了小节线。老师说：「这叫延音线——音是上一小节按下的，这一小节还在响。」她带小凡走到排练厅的荣誉墙前：「你看，咱们团的两本『账本』。排练日志是 G13 的过去戳：3 月 2 日排练，4 月 5 日演出——写完就翻篇，跟今天没关系。荣誉墙不一样：We have won three cups——什么时候赢的不重要，重要的是奖杯现在还在柜子里发光。过去按下的音，今天还在响，这就是现在完成时。」她指着墙上的七枚小标签：「KET 只考它的七个搭档。just——刚刚（I have just cleaned the cups）；already——已经（肯定句里）；yet——还没、了吗（专站否定句和问句的句尾）；never——从来没有；ever——曾经（Have you ever...?）；for——跟一段时长（for three years）；since——跟一个起点（since 2023）。」最后她敲了敲排练日志：「记住天条：yesterday、last week 这些翻篇的日子一出现，就回去找过去戳——延音线和旧日历不同台。」

cards.detail: 主语单数用 has，其余用 have（G25 的对齐规矩）；规则分词＝-ed，不规则分词是老团员的第三枚私章。
cards.example: I have finished. / She has seen it. / go-went-gone

cards.detail: 都站在 have/has 和分词中间：just 说「刚发生」，already 用在肯定句说「已经办妥」。
cards.example: I have just watered the plants. / She has already packed.

cards.detail: 专站否定句和疑问句的句尾。
cards.example: I haven't finished yet. / Have you eaten yet?

cards.detail: never 站中间表「一次也没有」；ever 多用于提问「有没有过」。
cards.example: I have never tried skating. / Have you ever seen snow?

cards.rule: for + 一段时长 ｜ since + 一个起点
cards.detail: for 后面跟「多久」（for two years / for a week）；since 后面跟「从哪一刻起」（since 2023 / since Monday）。
cards.example: We have lived here for ten years. / She has played the piano since 2022.

cards.rule: 天条：不跟翻篇的时间词同台
cards.detail: yesterday / last week / in 2020 / just now 一出现，改用一般过去时——延音线和旧日历不同台。
cards.example: I saw the film yesterday. ✓（不说 I have seen it yesterday）

basic.en: I have just finished my homework.
basic.cn: 我刚写完作业。（just 站中间）

basic.en: She has already fed the cat.
basic.cn: 她已经喂过猫了。（already 肯定句）
我们还没吃晚饭。（yet 押句尾）

basic.en: I have never seen the sea.
basic.cn: 我从来没见过大海。（never 一次也没有）

basic.en: Have you ever tried dumplings with fish?
basic.cn: 你吃过鱼肉馅的饺子吗？（ever 问「有没有过」）

mid.en: My uncle has worked in the bookshop for eight years.
mid.cn: 我叔叔在书店工作八年了。（for + 时长，现在还在干）
从周二起雨就没停过。（since + 起点）

mid.en: — Have you finished the poster yet? — Not yet.
mid.cn: ——海报做完了吗？——还没。（yet 一问一答）

mid.en: The little tree has grown a lot since spring.
mid.cn: 小树从春天到现在长高了不少。（grow-grew-grown）

mid.en: I have lost my library card, so I can't borrow books.
mid.cn: 我把借书卡弄丢了，所以现在借不了书。（延音：丢了→现在受影响）

trap.en: I saw that film last Saturday.
trap.cn: 我上周六看了那部电影。
trap.note: last Saturday 是翻篇的日子——用过去戳 saw，不用 have seen。

trap.en: She has kept this photo for twenty years.
trap.cn: 这张照片她保存二十年了。
trap.note: for + 一段时长——「二十年」是时长不是起点，别写 since twenty years。

trap.en: He has played the drums since he was six.
trap.note: since 也能挂一个过去的小句——小句里用过去时 was。

trap.en: Have you ever eaten mooncakes with egg yolk?
trap.note: eat 的第三枚私章是 eaten——ever 站在主语后。

trap.en: I have already returned the books, so my bag is light.
trap.cn: 书我已经还了，所以书包很轻。
trap.note: already 站中间；「现在书包轻」正是延音线还在响。

trap.en: My cousin has broken his arm, so he can't play this week.
trap.cn: 我表哥胳膊骨折了，这周不能上场。
trap.note: break-broke-broken——说「现在打不了」用延音线，不是翻篇的旧闻。

redBlack.bad: I live in this town for ten years.（想说已经住了十年还住着）
redBlack.good: I have lived in this town for ten years.
redBlack.why: 少了延音线，「住了十年」的分量全丢——听着像普通的「我住这儿」，十年白说了。

redBlack.bad: She learned English since 2022.（想说从 2022 学到现在）
redBlack.why: since 的起点挂在翻了篇的过去时上——线从起点断开，「一直学到现在」传不出去。

redBlack.bad: I have seen this film yesterday.
redBlack.why: 天条：延音线不跟 yesterday 这类翻篇时间词同台——改回过去戳。
has 后面要第三枚私章 gone——went 是第二枚，别拿错章。

redBlack.bad: We have knew each other for five years.
redBlack.good: We have known each other for five years.
redBlack.why: know 的第三枚私章是 known。

redBlack.bad: I have finished my homework yet.（想说已经写完）
redBlack.good: I have already finished my homework.
redBlack.why: yet 只站否定句和问句——肯定句的「已经」是 already。
she 配 has——G25 的对齐规矩在这里照样生效。

redBlack.bad: Do you have seen my ruler?
redBlack.why: 完成时提问由 have 自己举手搬家——不请 do。

redBlack.bad: They have waited since two hours.
redBlack.good: They have waited for two hours.
redBlack.why: 「两个小时」是一段时长——配 for；since 只挂起点。
never 站中间没错，但分词要用第三枚私章 eaten。

redBlack.bad: I just finished my juice.（美剧里常听到）
redBlack.good: 口语里美式常省 have；考试写 I have just finished。
redBlack.why: 美式口语 just + 过去式很常见——意思不挡，KET 作文按完整版写最稳。

redBlack.bad: I've finished already.（already 跑到句尾了）
redBlack.good: 已经对了——already 站中间或句尾都行。
redBlack.why: already 的位置比 yet 自由——句尾放着意思不变，考试不设坑。

contrast.diff: 中文的「过」和英语的完成时神似——都说「有过这段经历，跟现在的我有关」。

contrast.en: I ate.（翻篇）/ I have eaten.（现在不饿）
contrast.diff: 中文一个「了」既管翻篇又管延音；英语分成两套——想说「现在怎么样」就拉延音线。

contrast.cn: 我住这儿十年了。（句尾「了」表一直住着）
contrast.en: I have lived here for ten years.
contrast.diff: 中文靠句尾的「了」；英语靠 have + 分词 + for——三个零件一个不能少。

contrast.en: Have you finished yet? — Not yet.
contrast.diff: 中文的「吗／还没」；英语请 yet 站句尾，一问一答都用它。

contrast.cn: 昨天我看了那部电影。（想加「过」也行）
contrast.en: I saw that film yesterday.（只能过去时）
contrast.diff: 中文「了／过」跟昨天不打架；英语的延音线见到 yesterday 必须让位给过去戳。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 问自己：现在还响吗？响就 have+分词；just/already 站中间，yet 押句尾，for 配时长，since 挂起点。
steps: 先扫时间词：有 yesterday / last... / in 2020 → 翻篇了，用过去戳，别拉延音线。
问：这事对「现在」有影响吗（还在住、还没吃、经历还算数）？有 → have/has + 过去分词。
对齐 have/has（she/he/it 用 has），分词用第三枚私章（gone/seen/eaten）。
选搭档：刚刚 just、已经 already（肯定）、还没/了吗 yet（否定问句句尾）、从没 never、有没有过 ever。
说「多久」：一段时长配 for（for two years），一个起点配 since（since 2023）。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语有条『延音线』：过去做的事，现在还在起作用，就用 have 加动词的第三个样子。中文里咱们说『我去过长城』的『过』，就是这个味道。咱们玩『经历大调查』：你用 Have you ever...? 问我有没有做过一些事——有没有见过雪、吃过臭豆腐、养过金鱼，我用中文答，你再帮我翻成 Yes, I have 或 No, I never...。再玩『刚刚侦探』：家里谁刚做完一件事，你就用 I have just... 报告——弟弟刚喝完奶，你就说 He has just finished his milk。我不懂英语没关系，我只把一条门规：你要是说『昨天 I have seen』，我就喊『昨天的事翻篇啦』——昨天、上周这些词一出现，就不能用这条延音线。」
questions: 「我去过北京」和「我昨天去了北京」，英语里是同一种说法吗？差在哪？
「已经」「还没」分别请哪个搭档？yet 站在句子的什么位置？
for 和 since 怎么分工？「三年」跟谁，「2023 年起」跟谁？

sections.echo: have + 过去分词这套装备，最初真是「拥有」：古人说 I have the letter written——「我手里有一封写好了的信」。说得多了，「拥有」的意思被磨空，have 从实义动词退成了纯语法零件，专门负责把过去的事挂到现在——又是你熟悉的「语法化」：常用词被磨成工具（will、going to、because 都走过这条路）。所以完成时的骨子里还留着那层意思：I have finished ≈ 我「手握」一个已完成的结果。至于 been 和 gone 的分工、比过去更早的过去完成时——那些更深的延音技法，都留在进阶层 G27，等你上去再拉。

stages.name: 认一认 · 延音线入门

questions.q: 现在完成时的装备是？
questions.explain: 延音线两件套：have/has + 第三枚私章。

questions.q: 延音线说的是哪种事？
options: 过去发生、现在还有影响
questions.explain: 过去按下的音，现在还在响。

questions.q: she/he/it 后面用 have 还是 has？
questions.explain: G25 的对齐规矩——单数配 has。

questions.q: go 的第三枚私章（过去分词）是？
questions.explain: go-went-gone——has gone。

questions.q: eat 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: eat-ate-eaten。

questions.q: see 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: see-saw-seen。

questions.q: 「刚刚」用哪个搭档？
questions.explain: I have just finished——just 站中间。

questions.q: 肯定句里的「已经」用？
questions.explain: She has already packed。

questions.q: yet 站在句子的什么位置？
questions.explain: I haven't finished yet. / Have you eaten yet?

questions.q: 「从来没有」用哪个搭档？
questions.explain: I have never tried it。

questions.q: 问「有没有过某经历」用？
questions.explain: Have you ever seen snow?

questions.q: for 后面跟什么？
questions.explain: for + 多久。

questions.q: since 后面跟什么？
questions.explain: since + 从哪一刻起。

questions.q: 完成时能和 yesterday 同台吗？
options: 不能——翻篇的日子用过去时
questions.explain: 天条：延音线不跟旧日历同台。

questions.q: 完成时提问谁举手搬家？
questions.explain: Have you finished?——不请 do。

questions.q: KET 考纲要求完成时配几个搭档？
questions.explain: just/already/yet/never/ever/for/since——七个拉稳就是满分线。

questions.q: I have ___ finished the last page — one second ago!
questions.explain: 一秒前＝刚刚——just。

questions.q: She has ___ packed her schoolbag, so she is free now.
questions.explain: 肯定句的「已经」——already。

questions.q: We haven't watered the flowers ___.
questions.explain: 否定句句尾——yet。

questions.q: Have you cleaned your room ___?
questions.explain: 问句句尾——yet。

questions.q: I have ___ ridden a horse — not even once.
questions.explain: 一次也没有——never。

questions.q: Have you ___ tasted grandma's plum soup?
questions.explain: 问经历——ever。

questions.q: My parents have known each other ___ twenty years.
questions.explain: 二十年是时长——for。

questions.q: It has snowed ___ Friday night.
questions.explain: 周五晚是起点——since。

questions.q: He has ___ his key, so he is waiting at the door.
questions.explain: lose-lost-lost——延音：现在进不了门。

questions.q: The baby has ___ asleep — please walk quietly.
questions.explain: fall-fell-fallen——has fallen asleep。

questions.q: I have ___ this cartoon three times!
questions.explain: have + seen——第三枚私章。

questions.q: ___ you finished your milk yet?
questions.explain: have 自己举手——Have you...yet?

questions.q: She has played table tennis ___ she was seven.
questions.explain: since 挂过去起点小句——since she was seven。

questions.q: We have ___ a big paper star for the party.
questions.explain: make-made-made——have made。

questions.q: My cousin has ___ in that band for two years.
questions.explain: 规则分词照旧 -ed——has drummed for。

questions.q: The show has ___ started — hurry up!
questions.explain: 刚开场——just 站中间。

questions.q: 哪句没违反天条？
options: I visited the zoo last Sunday.
I have visited the zoo last Sunday.
I have visit the zoo last Sunday.
questions.explain: last Sunday 翻篇——过去戳 visited。

questions.q: 哪句的私章拿对了？
questions.explain: has + 第三枚私章 gone。

questions.q: 哪句的「已经」用对了？
options: I have already learned this song.
I have yet learned this song.
I have learned already this song yet.
questions.explain: 肯定句用 already 站中间。

questions.q: 哪句的 yet 站对了岗？
questions.explain: 否定句句尾——haven't...yet。

questions.q: 哪句的 have/has 对齐了？
options: My sister has just washed her hands.
My sister have just washed her hands.
My sister has just wash her hands.
questions.explain: sister→has；分词 washed。

questions.q: 哪句提问的手举对了？
options: Do you have found your glasses?
Did you have found your glasses?
questions.explain: have 自己搬家——Have you found...?

questions.q: 哪句的 for/since 分工对了？
options: We have waited for half an hour.
We have waited since half an hour.
We have waited for since Monday.
questions.explain: 半小时是时长——for。

questions.q: 哪句的起点挂对了？
options: She has kept a diary since 2024.
She has kept a diary for 2024.
questions.explain: 2024 是起点——since + 完成时。

questions.q: 哪句的 never 用得全对？
options: I never have eaten not durian.
questions.explain: never 站中间 + 分词 eaten。

questions.q: 哪句的 ever 问得对？
options: Has she ever won a prize?
Does she ever has won a prize?
Has she won ever a prize?
questions.explain: Has + 主语 + ever + 分词。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我刚接到你的电话）
options: I have just got your call.
I have just get your call.
I just have got your call yesterday.
questions.explain: just 站中间 + 分词 got；别再拖上 yesterday。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（他从六岁起就住在这条街）
options: He has lived on this street since he was six.
He has lived on this street for he was six.
He lived on this street since he was six.（想说现在还住）
questions.explain: since + 过去小句；主句拉延音线 has lived。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（作业写完了吗？——还没）
options: — Have you done your homework yet? — Not yet.
— Do you done your homework yet? — Not already.
— Have you done your homework already yet? — Not.
questions.explain: Have...yet? 答 Not yet——一对搭档。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（这块表我戴三年了）
options: I have worn this watch for three years.
I have worn this watch since three years.
I wear this watch for three years already yesterday.
questions.explain: wear-wore-worn + for 时长。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（雪从早上下到现在）
options: It has snowed since this morning.
It has snowed for this morning.
It snowed since this morning and stopped.（想说还在下）
questions.explain: this morning 是起点——since + 延音线。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我上周读完了这本书——翻篇陈述）
options: I finished this book last week.
I have finished this book last week.
I have finish this book last week.
questions.explain: last week 在场——老实用过去戳。

questions.q: — Why is Ben so happy? — He ___ his first medal!
questions.explain: 刚拿奖、现在还乐着——has just won。

questions.q: — Is Lily still at school? — No, she ___ home.
questions.explain: 人不在＝走了还没回——has gone home。

questions.q: I can't open the door because I ___ my key.
questions.explain: 现在进不了门——延音线 have lost。

questions.q: — ___ you ever ___ a night train? — Never, but I'd love to!
questions.explain: 问经历 Have you ever taken；答 Never。

questions.q: My grandpa ___ tai chi ___ ten years, and he still practises daily.
questions.explain: 还在练——延音线 + for 十年时长。

questions.q: — Have you fed the goldfish yet? — Yes, I ___ them.
questions.explain: 肯定回答换 already——have already fed。

questions.q: The city ___ a lot since my last visit — look at the new bridges!
questions.explain: since + 延音线——变化持续到眼前。

questions.q: 先分辨再选：— When did you buy this kite? — I ___ it two weeks ago.
questions.explain: 问 when、答 two weeks ago——翻篇事件用过去戳。

questions.q: 再分辨：— How long have you had this kite? — I ___ it ___ two weeks.
questions.explain: How long + 延音线——have had it for two weeks。

questions.q: — Hurry, the film ___! — Don't worry, only the ads have started.
questions.explain: begin-began-begun——has already begun。

questions.q: We ___ each other ___ we were in kindergarten.
questions.explain: 认识延续到现在——have known since + 过去小句。

questions.q: — Why is the kitchen so clean? — Mum ___ it.
questions.explain: 眼前的干净是延音——has just cleaned。

questions.q: I ___ my homework, ___ I haven't checked it ___.
questions.explain: 已完成 + 转折 + 还没检查：but...yet。

questions.q: — Has your class picked a song for the show yet? — ___
options: Not yet. We are still choosing.
questions.explain: 还没选好——Not yet + 补充。

questions.q: 选出「经历访谈」全对的一组：
options: — Have you ever climbed a snow mountain? — No, I never have. But my dad has climbed two!
— Did you ever climbed a snow mountain? — No, I never. But my dad has climb two!
— Have you ever climb a snow mountain? — No, I haven't ever never.
questions.explain: ever 问、never 答、has climbed 接力——七搭档的标准用法。

questions.q: 大考：Our band ___ together ___ 2023. We ___ thirty songs, but we haven't performed on TV ___.
options: has played / since / have learned / yet
has played / for / have learned / never
questions.explain: since 2023 起点 + 延音线；成果 have learned；否定句尾 yet——收官大考四关全过。

detective.sentence: I have watched that cartoon last night.
detective.fixed: I watched that cartoon last night.
detective.clue: last night 是翻篇的日子——延音线不跟旧日历同台，用过去戳。

detective.sentence: She has went to the library to return the books.
detective.fixed: She has gone to the library to return the books.
detective.clue: has 后面要第三枚私章 gone——went 是第二枚，拿错章了。

detective.sentence: We have lived in this building since eight years.
detective.fixed: We have lived in this building for eight years.
detective.clue: 「八年」是一段时长——配 for；since 只挂起点。

detective.sentence: I have finished my project yet, so I can rest.
detective.fixed: I have already finished my project, so I can rest.
detective.clue: yet 只站否定句和问句——肯定句的「已经」请 already。

detective.sentence: Do you have ever seen a real panda?
detective.fixed: Have you ever seen a real panda?
detective.clue: 完成时提问由 have 自己举手搬家——不请 do。

detective.sentence: My brother have just broken his toy robot.
detective.fixed: My brother has just broken his toy robot.
detective.clue: brother 是单数——配 has；声部对齐的老规矩。

detective.sentence: I have never rode a camel before.
detective.fixed: I have never ridden a camel before.
detective.clue: ride 的第三枚私章是 ridden——never 没病，别多改。
